data.revised_prompt:
Edit the provided scientific-educational journal figure (wide 1536x512) while preserving the overall differentiable-simulation style and layout. Keep the pale blue time-step panels, the top state circles, grayscale depth thumbnails, black forward arrows, red backward arrows, legend, and compact loss boxes. Preserve variables and modules exactly as shown: x_k,c_k, S_phi, D_obs,k, Pi_theta, Pi_f, Pi_c, u_k, c*_{k+1}, EMA, f_dyn, L_sens / L_teach, L_flight. Do not add Q_t, M_t, or a separate R renderer.

Primary correction: in every time-step panel, make the forward perception-to-policy path unmistakable. Add a clear black downward arrow from S_phi to the depth thumbnail labeled D_obs,k. Add a clear black arrow from the D_obs,k thumbnail into the Pi_theta policy block. The depth observation must be the dominant policy input, while keeping the optional state/context input from the top state node to Pi_theta.

Policy structure: Pi_theta must remain one split policy block with two heads only: Pi_f -> u_k and Pi_c -> c*_{k+1}. Do not make Pi_f and Pi_c sequential. Pi_f outputs u_k to f_dyn. Pi_c outputs c*_{k+1} to EMA.

State update: f_dyn outputs x_{k+1}. EMA outputs c_{k+1}. The next state circle combines x_{k+1}, c_{k+1}. Do not draw EMA feeding f_dyn or f_dyn feeding EMA.

Backward gradients: keep red gradients from L_flight back to f_dyn, Pi_theta, D_obs,k, and S_phi. Keep red gradients from L_sens / L_teach back to S_phi and c_k. Keep the "dL/dc_k" label near the camera-state gradient.

Style: large clean labels, smooth non-crossing arrows, preserve grayscale depth thumbnails as image patches, no clutter, no tiny text, no watermark/logo. Ensure the forward path is visually clear in all panels.
